decision_rules.add: At least two independent use cases and no clear existing owner
decision_rules.merge: Substantially overlapping triggers, workflow, and maintained knowledge
decision_rules.deprecate: No current evidence, superseded capability, or maintenance cost exceeds value

latest_review.reason: The current topology review found no missing, duplicate, or deprecated top-level owner boundary, so the active surface remains 23. They now act as specialist Agents under the one durable global-experience-agent root through config/global-experience-agent-registry.json and config/agent-owner-connections.json. Five concept Agents compose existing specialists without adding duplicate owners; bounded child Agents use delegated, completed, joined, and cancelled states; authorized callers and compatible model hosts continue by durable session id rather than chat or provider identity. Iteration, self-evolution, Git, experience, knowledge, error feedback, runtime, credentials, and delivery remain capabilities behind their existing owner and tool gates. Runtime, topology, portability, child lifecycle, presentation, reachability, return-path, and save-point correspondence are behaviorally tested.
